T003 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (V n)),
  IsCompact E →
    Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
      (∃ B, 1 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ‖x‖ ≤ B) ∧
        (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
            0 < s →
              0 < δ →
                ∃ k U,
                  E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin k), Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) ∧ ∑ i, Metric.ediam (U i) ^ s < ∞) ∧
          ∀ (s δ : ℝ), 0 < s → 0 < δ → Hscale s δ E < ∞
'Translation.T003' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
